Tribute to arrival checks
Autumn has been kind to the desk
Clear paws, calm moves

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is seeing steadier arrivals, and that means the whole team must stay sharp on every handoff. Keep carriers labeled, keep notes current, and watch for small changes that can turn into big delays if they are missed. The ground team has been especially careful with transfers, and that steady pace is helping travelers feel settled before they even reach the gate. <<FACT F010>> Each check should stay warm in tone, firm in process, and quick enough to keep the line moving without confusion.

Staff should also keep the pet relief route in mind, because a smooth pause there can make the rest of the journey easier. <<FACT F016>> When travelers ask for guidance, answer plainly, repeat key steps once, and make sure the desk ledger reflects any service update before the next handoff. Aurelia Skyways depends on this quiet discipline, and the desk is at its best when every detail is handled with care.
